questions.question: Where are Meg and Daryl working?

options.text: Shopwell Supermarket
City Hall
A school library

questions.explanation: 开头说明 Meg 和 Daryl 正在 Shopwell Supermarket 补充货架上的商品。

questions.question: What steps out of the damaged bakery?

options.text: A fire warrior
A large pig
A small monkey

questions.explanation: 面包店正面炸开后，一头大猪走出，Roxy 因而发现小偷的身份。

questions.question: Why does Meg suggest stacking the tomatoes near the cash registers?

options.text: The customers have already bought them.
Daryl wants to eat them.
There is not enough room on the shelf.

questions.explanation: 货架放不下多余的番茄罐头，因此 Meg 建议将它们堆在收银台附近。

questions.question: Why does Miss Apricot give Jack a stern look?

options.text: He leaves school to fight the thief.
He is searching for his pencil instead of reading.
He refuses to eat his lunch.

questions.explanation: Jack 在地上找铅笔，没有按要求安静阅读。

questions.question: Why is the food thief a bigger problem than Roxy first expects?

options.text: He has eaten the food at several businesses.
He has stolen only one sandwich.
He has hidden the mayor’s lunch.

questions.explanation: 市长说明小偷吃光了超市、其他食品店和餐馆的食物，事情比一顿饭未付款严重得多。

questions.question: What weapon does Zhu Bajie carry?

options.text: A bow
A rake
A sword

questions.explanation: 原文中 Detective Smith 指出猪拿着一把耙子，八戒也用它抵挡激光。

questions.question: Where does Roxy find Bajie asleep?

options.text: On a supermarket shelf
Inside City Hall
In the school equipment shed

questions.explanation: Roxy 循着鼾声来到学校器材室，发现八戒睡在体育垫上。

questions.question: Which ability does Bajie use to escape from Roxy?

options.text: Freezing the sidewalk
Flying away on a cloud
Shooting laser beams

questions.explanation: Detective Smith 看到猪乘云飞走，这是八戒逃离现场时使用的能力。

questions.question: Why does Roxy stop chasing Bajie after he throws the sign?

options.text: She goes to check on the truck driver.
She decides Bajie is harmless.
She goes back to finish lunch.

questions.explanation: 标牌击中经过的卡车并造成事故，Roxy 先去查看司机状况。

questions.question: How does Roxy finally catch Bajie?

options.text: She takes his rake while he is eating.
She follows him onto his cloud.
She carries him away while he is sleeping.

questions.explanation: Roxy 听到鼾声，找到睡在体育垫上的八戒，然后轻轻将他带走。

3.title: A Change in the Weather Quiz

questions.question: Where do Wukong and his companions wake up?

options.text: In Metro City jail
On a ship
In a meadow

questions.explanation: 开头写悟空和同伴在草地上醒来，周围有蜜蜂、鸟鸣与微风。

questions.question: What surprises Wukong when he returns to the ground?

options.text: The village has disappeared
Bajie has become a horse
The rain has stopped forever

questions.explanation: 悟空回到地面时发现整个村庄不见了，因此惊呼。

questions.question: How does the meadow seem at the beginning?

options.text: Peaceful and pleasant
Crowded and dangerous
Cold and silent

questions.explanation: 蜜蜂、鸟鸣和轻柔的微风使开头的草地显得平静宜人。

questions.question: What do the demons hope to gain by eating the Tang Monk?

options.text: A way to enter Metro City
A new iron bar
The ability to live forever

questions.explanation: 妖怪认为吃掉唐僧就能长生不老。

questions.question: Why does Wukong think the demons’ rain plan is foolish?

options.text: He thinks the village has no food.
He thinks rain will not hurt his master.
He knows Bajie controls the rain.

questions.explanation: 悟空当时认为下雨不会伤害师父，因此觉得妖怪的计划愚蠢。

4.title: A Goddess from Another World Quiz

questions.question: Why do the demons want to eat the Tang Monk?

options.text: They believe it will let them live forever
They want to become police officers
They want to return a stolen jar

questions.explanation: 妖怪相信吃唐僧能够长生不老，这是他们绑架他的动机。

questions.question: How does Bajie enter the other world?

options.text: He swims across the South Sea
He trips and stumbles through a portal
He rides a bus through a tunnel

questions.explanation: 八戒冲进王座厅时被碗绊倒，跌进传送门；门随后关闭。

questions.question: What do the captured travelers regret?

options.text: Not bringing enough food
Not asking the mayor for help
Not listening to Wukong’s warning

questions.explanation: 被绑住后，唐僧和悟净意识到应该听悟空的警告。

questions.question: Why do some demons become afraid to eat the Tang Monk?

options.text: They hear police approaching.
They fear Wukong will attack them.
They think the monk is another demon.

questions.explanation: 妖怪听说悟空很强大，担心吃掉唐僧后遭到他的攻击。

questions.question: What does Swift Wing say the spell can do?

options.text: Open a portal to another world
Make the Tang Monk invisible
Turn the demon into a goddess

questions.explanation: Swift Wing 解释咒语能够打开通往另一个世界的传送门。

questions.question: Why does Bajie say he ate the food?

options.text: He was following the mayor’s orders
He was hungry
He was collecting it for a picnic

questions.explanation: 八戒接受询问时直接解释自己吃食物是因为饥饿。

questions.question: Who tells Wukong she knows where his friend is?

options.text: Detective Smith
Miss Apricot
A bird demon

questions.explanation: 悟空拦住的鸟妖告诉他，她知道他的朋友在哪里。

questions.question: What does Wukong demand at the mountain door?

options.text: That Bajie return his cloud
That the demons release his master
That the demons give him food

questions.explanation: 悟空在山门前要求妖怪立即释放师父。

questions.question: What do the travelers think Bajie has gone to do?

options.text: Find food
Warn the Jade Emperor
Look for Rocket Girl

questions.explanation: 唐僧认为八戒一直抱怨饿，可能去找食物了。

questions.question: Why does Wukong stop the bird demon?

options.text: He sees her attack Detective Smith.
He wants her to teach him to fly.
He notices her trying to sneak past him.

questions.explanation: 悟空听到脚步声，察觉鸟妖想偷偷经过，便挡住了她。

questions.question: Why does Wukong enter the portal?

options.text: To buy sandwiches
To meet Detective Smith for a quiz
To find Bajie

questions.explanation: 唐僧提醒悟空必须找到八戒，悟空随后跳入传送门寻找他。

questions.question: Who appears again before the Tang Monk at the end?

options.text: The Demon of Black Rain
Mayor Bloom
Roxy’s teacher

questions.explanation: 悟净离开后，唐僧睁眼看到的并非悟净，而是再次出现的黑雨妖。

questions.question: Why is the Demon of Black Rain upset at the beginning?

options.text: Wukong forced him to flee his mountain.
Bajie ate his dinner in Metro City.
Swift Wing destroyed his portal.

questions.explanation: 妖怪说悟空突然袭击，迫使他逃离自己的山。

questions.question: How does Wukong react to the claim that a goddess could defeat him?

options.text: He asks the goddess to become his teacher.
He agrees to stop using his powers.
He angrily insists nobody can defeat him.

questions.explanation: 悟空握拳叫喊无人能打败他，表现出愤怒和自负。

questions.question: Why does Wujing leave the resting Tang Monk?

options.text: To bring the demon some dinner
To check on the horse outside
To search for Bajie in Metro City

questions.explanation: 悟净让师父休息，自己出去查看马。

7.title: A Monkey in Metro City Quiz

questions.question: What are Roxy and her friends doing in Jack’s backyard?

options.text: Playing catch
Studying a map of the South Sea
Preparing a royal feast

questions.explanation: 本集开头 Roxy 与朋友到 Jack 后院玩接球游戏。

questions.question: How does Roxy help the falling car’s driver?

options.text: She tells him to jump into a portal
She catches the car and puts it down
She changes the car into a bird

questions.explanation: Roxy 在汽车落地前接住它，并小心放下，救了司机。

questions.question: Why does Terrell think the pig is a villain?

options.text: The pig stole his schoolbook.
The mayor told him the pig was a demon.
He saw the pig attacking Rocket Girl.

questions.explanation: Terrell 根据猪攻击 Rocket Girl 的行为判断它是坏人。

questions.question: What shows that people downtown are frightened?

options.text: They are cheering for Wukong.
They are running in every direction.
They are waiting calmly for a bus.

questions.explanation: Roxy 到达市中心时看到人们四处奔逃，说明他们十分害怕。

questions.question: How does Wukong misunderstand the approaching bus?

options.text: He thinks it is trying to attack him.
He thinks it will take him to school.
He thinks Bajie is driving it.

questions.explanation: 悟空面对公交车喊不要攻击他，误将车辆当成攻击者。

questions.question: What does Wukong strike with his iron bar?

options.text: A supermarket shelf
A bus
A fishing boat

questions.explanation: 悟空用铁棒击打公交车，车辆撞上垃圾桶，乘客惊慌逃离。

questions.question: Who does Wukong believe Roxy is?

options.text: The mountain’s spirit
A messenger from City Hall
The goddess Swift Wing described

questions.explanation: 悟空把 Roxy 当成 Swift Wing 所说、会帮助黑雨妖的女神。

questions.question: Why do the passengers hurry off the bus?

options.text: The driver has reached their stop.
Wukong has struck it with his iron bar.
Rocket Girl asks them to play catch.

questions.explanation: 悟空击打公交车后，乘客惊叫着逃下车。

questions.question: What makes Wukong decide he needs more of his powers?

options.text: He realizes Roxy is stronger than he expected.
He discovers his iron bar is missing.
He thinks Roxy cannot fly.

questions.explanation: 悟空原以为 Roxy 只是小妖，交手后意识到需要使用更多神通。

questions.question: Why is Wukong angry when he thinks Roxy is the goddess?

options.text: He believes she has eaten Bajie’s food.
He believes she wants his iron bar.
He believes she plans to help destroy him.

questions.explanation: Swift Wing 的说法让悟空以为她将帮助黑雨妖消灭自己。

questions.question: What happens after Wukong falls backward on the mountain?

options.text: A bakery opens
The Tang Monk arrives in a taxi
An avalanche rushes downward

questions.explanation: Roxy 将悟空击倒后山体震动，引发雪崩，积雪向下奔涌。

questions.question: How does Wukong get Roxy out of his way?

options.text: He makes her fly through the portal and closes it
He takes away her watch
He locks her inside the school

questions.explanation: 悟空引诱 Roxy 冲向自己，在她面前打开传送门，再将门关闭。

questions.question: What surprises Roxy about Wukong’s size?

options.text: He can grow taller than the buildings.
He becomes smaller than her watch.
He cannot change his size.

questions.explanation: 悟空不断变大，高过城市建筑，让 Roxy 大吃一惊。

questions.question: Why does Wukong change his approach near the end?

options.text: He has lost all his super powers.
He learns that Bajie is the mayor.
He realizes neither fighter can destroy the other.

questions.explanation: 悟空意识到双方都无法消灭对方，因此另想办法摆脱 Roxy。

questions.question: What happens immediately after the tiny Wukongs return?

options.text: Bajie opens the cave door.
Roxy chases them toward the real Wukong.
The ranger arrests them all.

questions.explanation: 小悟空返回后，Roxy 追着他们冲向真正的悟空，落入传送门计策。

questions.question: What has disappeared from Roxy’s surroundings?

options.text: Metro City
All the mountains
The dirt road

questions.explanation: Roxy 环顾四周发现只有荒野，熟悉的 Metro City 已消失。

questions.question: What does the squire ask Roxy about?

options.text: Whether she is the Tang Monk’s teacher
Whether she comes from another world
Whether she works at the supermarket

questions.explanation: 乡绅凑近询问 Roxy 是否来自另一个世界。

questions.question: Why does Roxy feel lost?

options.text: Her teacher has changed the classroom.
Her friends refuse to speak to her.
Her familiar city is gone and she does not know where she is.

questions.explanation: Roxy 发现周围变成陌生的荒野，Metro City 也不见了。

questions.question: Why do the men decide to run away?

options.text: They see the Tang Monk approaching.
They believe Roxy is a spirit.
They hear Detective Smith’s siren.

questions.explanation: 那些人见识了 Roxy 的力量，以为她是神灵，害怕地逃走。

questions.question: How does Roxy describe her home to the squire?

options.text: It is very different from this place.
It is on the same dirt road.
It is inside the nearby mountain.

questions.explanation: Roxy 说自己的家与这里很不一样，呼应她来自另一个世界。

questions.question: Why is Roxy suspicious of the squire’s explanation?

options.text: He says he is Detective Smith
She did not see his servants until after the fight
He refuses to speak to her

questions.explanation: Roxy 记得打斗结束后才见到仆人，因此怀疑他们目击打斗的说法。

questions.question: Which place is being robbed?

options.text: Metro City Elementary School
The Jade Emperor’s garden
True Savings Bank

questions.explanation: 市长接到电话后说明 True Savings Bank 正遭抢劫。

questions.question: How does the squire explain knowing about Roxy’s powers?

options.text: He says he saw her on television.
He says his servants told him.
He says Mayor Bloom sent a letter.

questions.explanation: 乡绅称仆人告诉了他关于 Roxy 超能力的事。

questions.question: How does Wukong explain the trouble he caused yesterday?

options.text: He calls it a misunderstanding.
He says he was following the mayor’s orders.
He admits he wanted to rob the bank.

questions.explanation: 悟空将昨天的冲突解释为一场大误会。

questions.question: Why does Wukong offer to go to the bank?

options.text: Bajie is working there.
Detective Smith asks him to open an account.
Rocket Girl does not answer the mayor’s call.

questions.explanation: 市长联系不上 Rocket Girl，悟空主动表示可以赶去帮忙。

questions.question: How does Wukong frighten the bank robbers?

options.text: He brings a fire warrior
He gives them a spelling test
He grows tall and his eyes turn red

questions.explanation: 悟空变大、双眼变红，令 Dwight 和 Earl 惊叫着跑出银行。

questions.question: What does Roxy hear while staying with the squire?

options.text: Someone crying
A school bell
The mayor singing

questions.explanation: Roxy 在乡绅家中用超级听力听到有人哭泣，于是开始留意。

questions.question: Why does Wukong initially ask about demons at the bank?

options.text: He assumes the robbers may be demons.
He already knows Earl is a demon.
He has seen Black Rain hiding there.

questions.explanation: 悟空用自己熟悉的世界理解事件，问抢银行的是不是妖怪。

questions.question: How do Dwight and Earl react before Wukong grows tall?

options.text: They immediately surrender.
They ask him to protect the bank.
They laugh at him.

questions.explanation: 两人先大笑，悟空变大后他们才惊叫逃跑。

questions.question: Why is Roxy anxious despite enjoying her stay?

options.text: She thinks the squire cannot cook.
She worries Wukong may be damaging Metro City.
She wants to finish her school lunch.

questions.explanation: Roxy 担心悟空在她不在时给 Metro City 造成破坏。

questions.question: How does Roxy see the prisoners through the walls?

options.text: With her x-ray vision
With a mirror
With a phone camera

questions.explanation: Roxy 用透视能力看穿墙壁，在暗室中发现被捆的唐僧和悟净。

questions.question: How does Wukong recognize Bajie in jail?

options.text: By his uniform
By his snoring
By his handwriting

questions.explanation: 悟空听到熟悉的鼾声，因此认出牢房里熟睡的大猪就是八戒。

questions.question: Why could Wujing not protect the horse and return safely?

options.text: He fell asleep in the jail.
He lost his way in Metro City.
Too many demons attacked him.

questions.explanation: 悟净说查看马时遭到大量妖怪攻击，无法全部击退。

questions.question: Why is the Tang Monk crying?

options.text: He thinks Roxy stole his horse.
He fears they will be eaten and never reach their destination.
He has lost his picnic sandwiches.

questions.explanation: 唐僧担心无法到达西天，而且即将被妖怪吃掉。

questions.question: What surprises Dwight and Earl about the squirrel?

options.text: It can talk and change shape.
It carries a police notebook.
It eats all the bank’s food.

questions.explanation: 两人听到松鼠说话，随后看到它改变形态。

questions.question: What news alert does Mara receive?

options.text: The South Sea has frozen
The pig has escaped jail with help from a talking monkey
Rocket Girl has become mayor

questions.explanation: Mara 的手机通知说那头猪越狱了，一只会说话的猴子帮助了他。

questions.question: What drives Roxy out of the cave?

options.text: A police car
A flock of ordinary birds
The demon’s wind and rain

questions.explanation: 妖怪的风雨卷起 Roxy，将她撞向洞壁并抛出洞外。

questions.question: How does Bajie react when Wukong wakes him?

options.text: He refuses to open his eyes.
He falls off his cot.
He attacks Wukong with a sword.

questions.explanation: 八戒被叫醒时猛地坐起，从简易床上摔下来。

questions.question: Why does Roxy rush toward the door in the cave?

options.text: She wants to free the prisoners.
She wants to hide from the mountain’s spirit.
She wants to steal the demon’s jar.

questions.explanation: Roxy 明确表示要立即解救囚犯，然后冲向门口。

questions.question: What happens after the wind throws Roxy outside?

options.text: Wukong carries her back to jail.
The demon asks her to return for dinner.
The cave door slams shut.

questions.explanation: 风雨把 Roxy 抛出洞穴后，洞门猛地关上。

questions.question: Why does Wukong plan to visit Fruit and Flower Mountain?

options.text: To buy food for Bajie
To find a new school
To get an army to take over the kingdom

questions.explanation: 悟空准备返回花果山召集军队，以便夺取这个王国。

questions.question: Who warns Roxy not to return up the mountain?

options.text: An old woman
Jack
A bank robber

questions.explanation: Roxy 想再次上山时，一名老妇出现，警告她不要返回。

questions.question: How does Bajie feel about Wukong finding him?

options.text: Relieved that he is not alone in the strange world
Angry that he must leave the bakery
Certain that he can defeat Roxy by himself

questions.explanation: 八戒说自己曾害怕独自困在这个世界，因此很高兴悟空找到他。

questions.question: What does Bajie want to do before returning to their master?

options.text: Become a police officer
Visit Roxy’s classroom
Take a nap

questions.explanation: 八戒躺下，表示先小睡，再回到师父身边。

questions.question: Why does Roxy still need another plan against the demon?

options.text: He has turned her into a monkey.
His wind and rain keep throwing her away.
He has stolen her watch.

questions.explanation: Roxy 的攻击再次被妖怪的风雨打断，并被卷下山，说明现有方法无效。

questions.question: Who does the old woman say she is?

options.text: The mountain’s spirit
Roxy’s teacher
The bakery owner

questions.explanation: 老妇明确说明自己是这座山的山神。

questions.question: What has taken over Metro City?

options.text: A fleet of ships
An army of monkeys and apes
A group of schoolchildren

questions.explanation: 市长跑来报告，猴子和猿组成的军队已经占领 Metro City。

questions.question: What is the Tang Monk hoping to receive from Buddha?

options.text: A throne for Metro City
A new rake for Bajie
The True Scriptures

questions.explanation: 山神解释唐僧西行是为了向佛祖求取真经。

questions.question: Why are the scriptures important to the Tang Empire?

options.text: They will give the emperor Roxy’s powers.
They will help people learn to be good.
They will turn everyone into a spirit.

questions.explanation: 原文说明真经能够帮助唐朝的人们向善。

questions.question: Why is Mayor Bloom out of breath?

options.text: He ran from City Hall to police headquarters.
He fought Wukong in the mountains.
He carried Bajie to jail.

questions.explanation: 市长说自己从市政厅一路跑来，因此上气不接下气。

17.title: The King of Metro City Quiz

questions.question: What does Mayor Bloom report about Wukong?

options.text: He is helping stock supermarket shelves
He has taken over City Hall as king
He has returned to the Western Paradise

questions.explanation: 市长描述悟空走进办公室坐在他的桌旁，并被宣布为城市的王。

questions.question: What does the spirit tell the demon the goddess plans to do?

options.text: Become queen of Metro City
Steal the mayor’s phone
Rescue the Tang Monk

questions.explanation: 山神告诉妖怪，女神将上山营救唐僧。

questions.question: What makes the invading monkeys look like an army?

options.text: They bring food for a picnic.
They wear armor and carry weapons.
They carry schoolbooks and pencils.

questions.explanation: 市长描述猴子和猿穿盔甲，并拿着矛、斧头和剑。

questions.question: What does Bajie order the guards to do?

options.text: Put the man in jail
Bring Rocket Girl a meal
Return the mayor’s phone

questions.explanation: 八戒对卫兵下令把这个人关进监狱。

questions.question: How does the demon react to the warning about the goddess?

options.text: He immediately frees the Tang Monk.
He abandons the mountain without a fight.
He says he will be ready for her.

questions.explanation: 妖怪并未释放唐僧，而是表示将做好迎战准备。

questions.question: How does Roxy trap the demon temporarily?

options.text: She makes him fall asleep
She shrinks him into a squirrel
She freezes his rain into ice around him

questions.explanation: Roxy 用冰冻气息冻住妖怪的雨，让妖怪被封在冰中。

questions.question: What do the travelers reveal about the horse?

options.text: It is actually a dragon
It belongs to Mayor Bloom
It cannot leave the mountain

questions.explanation: 悟净解释，同行的那匹马实际上是一条龙。

questions.question: Why does the demon question the spirit’s help?

options.text: He knows he took over her mountain.
He thinks she comes from Metro City.
He has already freed her friends.

questions.explanation: 妖怪觉得自己霸占了她的山，因此奇怪她为什么还帮助自己。

questions.question: Why must Roxy act quickly after freezing the rain?

options.text: The Tang Monk wants to have a picnic.
The horse is about to fly away.
The ice will not hold the demon for long.

questions.explanation: 山神提醒妖怪的雨不会被冻结很久，Roxy 必须抓紧时间。

questions.question: What suggests the danger is not over after the rescue?

options.text: Wujing explains that the horse is a dragon.
Dark clouds form and wind comes down the mountain.
The travelers stop to rest.

questions.explanation: 众人离山后出现阴云与山风，预示妖怪还可能追来。

19.title: The Search for Mount Potalaka Quiz

questions.question: Why must Roxy and the travelers hurry away?

options.text: The spirit cannot hold the powerful demon back for long
They need to catch a school bus
Their picnic sandwiches are ready

questions.explanation: 山神说明妖怪很强，她无法长时间阻挡他，众人必须赶快逃走。

questions.question: Where is Mount Potalaka said to be?

options.text: On Fruit and Flower Mountain
In the South Sea
Inside Metro City

questions.explanation: 悟净明确指出普陀山位于南海，并告诉 Roxy 如何寻找。

questions.question: How does the mountain’s spirit help the group escape?

options.text: She turns everyone into birds.
She takes them to Metro City in a taxi.
She holds back the demon for a short time.

questions.explanation: 山神利用对山中事物的控制暂时阻挡妖怪，让众人逃离。

questions.question: Why is Roxy worried about returning home?

options.text: She thinks Bajie has eaten her watch.
She does not know how to defeat Wukong.
She has forgotten where her school is.

questions.explanation: Roxy 认为悟空与自己一样强大，不知道回城后如何对付他。

questions.question: How does Roxy feel after flying over the whole sea?

options.text: Frustrated because she has not found the mountain
Pleased because Wukong is waiting there
Certain that Metro City is below her

questions.explanation: Roxy 飞越整个海域仍未找到目标，发出抱怨，表现出挫败感。

20.title: All Hail the Monkey King Quiz

questions.question: Whom is Roxy trying to find?

options.text: Miss Apricot
The bodhisattva Guanyin
The bakery owner

questions.explanation: Roxy 向老妇说明，她正在寻找居住在普陀山的观音菩萨。

questions.question: Where does Wukong sit as king?

options.text: On a gym mat inside the school
In Detective Smith’s office
On a throne outside City Hall

questions.explanation: 悟空坐在市政厅外高台中央的华丽王座上，身后站着猴子和猿。

questions.question: What does Wukong enjoy about his new position?

options.text: Studying with Miss Apricot
Ruling over a kingdom again
Working in a food store

questions.explanation: 悟空说自己很怀念统治王国的感觉，说明他享受称王。

questions.question: How does Bajie compare ruling the city with the journey west?

options.text: He thinks ruling is more fun.
He thinks traveling west is easier and more fun.
He thinks both activities are boring.

questions.explanation: 八戒认为统治城市比西行更有趣。

questions.question: How does Roxy challenge Wukong in front of the crowd?

options.text: She asks to become his guard.
She offers him the mayor’s throne.
She tells him he is not their king.

questions.explanation: Roxy 当众否认悟空对城市的王权。

questions.question: What does Wukong announce to Detective Smith?

options.text: He will close every school
He has destroyed the South Sea
He is no longer king

questions.explanation: 悟空告诉 Detective Smith 自己不再是国王，让市长重新管理城市。

questions.question: What does Wukong say is approaching during the picnic?

options.text: An army of demons
A group of shop workers
A school sports team

questions.explanation: 众人以为要下暴雨时，悟空指出来的是一支妖怪军队。

questions.question: What happens just as Wukong prepares to fight Roxy?

options.text: He falls down holding his head in pain.
He grows taller than City Hall.
He changes into a fire warrior.

questions.explanation: 悟空准备出手时突然倒地，抱头疼痛地翻滚。

questions.question: What does Jack suggest before the travelers continue their journey?

options.text: A visit to the bank
A flight over the South Sea
A picnic in the park

questions.explanation: Jack 建议先在公园野餐，然后众人再继续旅程。

questions.question: Why does Terrell think the picnic cannot happen?

options.text: He hears the mayor cancel the event.
He thinks a storm is approaching.
He sees that all the sandwiches are gone.

questions.explanation: Terrell 看到雷雨征兆，以为暴风雨将至，野餐无法进行。

questions.question: How does the demon stop Roxy’s freeze breath at first?

options.text: He catches it in a jar
He hides behind City Hall
He asks Bajie to eat it

questions.explanation: 妖怪举起小罐子，Roxy 的冰冻气息进入罐中并消失。

questions.question: What trick helps Roxy and Wukong trap the demon?

options.text: They replace his army with schoolchildren
Wukong makes them look like each other
They pretend to fall asleep

questions.explanation: 悟空让两人外貌互换，骗过妖怪的防备，使冰冻攻击成功。

questions.question: What does Black Rain declare when he arrives in the park?

options.text: He wants to become Wukong’s friend.
He has come to return the Tang Monk.
The kingdom is now his.

questions.explanation: 黑雨妖看中这个王国，当场宣称它归自己所有。

questions.question: Why does Roxy’s repeated freeze attack fail at first?

options.text: Her friends take away her powers.
The demon keeps catching it in his jar.
The Tang Monk blocks her view.

questions.explanation: 妖怪反复用罐子收走冰冻气息，导致 Roxy 的攻击失效。

questions.question: Why do Roxy and Wukong turn their attention away from the trapped demon?

options.text: Other demons surround their friends and the Tang Monk.
They hear the mayor calling them for lunch.
They see the mountain’s spirit fly away.

questions.explanation: Mara 呼救后，两人看到朋友和唐僧被其他妖怪包围。

23.title: A Chase Through the Portal Quiz

questions.question: Why does Wukong lower his iron bar at the beginning?

options.text: His iron bar has vanished
The demons threaten the Tang Monk and Roxy’s friends
He wants to return to class

questions.explanation: 妖怪抓住唐僧并威胁 Roxy 的朋友，悟空因此放下铁棒，不能贸然进攻。

questions.question: What is left after Wukong strikes the demon?

options.text: A large dragon
A gold crown
A small salamander

questions.explanation: 悟空击中妖怪后，妖怪消失，原地剩下一只小蝾螈。

questions.question: Why do Bajie and Wujing fail to help at first?

options.text: They have returned to the Western Paradise.
The demons have beaten them up.
They are sleeping at the bakery.

questions.explanation: 两人躺在地上，八戒说明他们被妖怪打倒了。

questions.question: What happens to the jar when the demon falls backward?

options.text: He drops it.
It turns into Wukong’s iron bar.
Bajie eats it.

questions.explanation: 妖怪后退跌倒时掉落了罐子，为之后的攻击提供机会。

questions.question: Why does Wukong want to destroy the salamander?

options.text: He thinks it belongs to the mayor.
He thinks it stole his schoolbook.
He believes it is still an evil spirit.

questions.explanation: 悟空强调蝾螈并不可爱，而是必须消灭的邪灵。

questions.question: Where did the salamander escape from?

options.text: A school equipment shed
A supermarket freezer
A pond in the Jade Emperor’s garden

questions.explanation: 火武士解释，蝾螈是从玉帝花园的池塘里逃出来的。

questions.question: How does Terrell explain Roxy’s return?

options.text: He says he texted her after she returned from visiting family
He says she arrived on Wukong’s cloud
He says Detective Smith released her from jail

questions.explanation: Terrell 称 Roxy 刚探亲回来，自己发消息让她来见大家，帮助掩饰身份。

questions.question: What does the fire warrior explain about the jar?

options.text: The salamander stole it from Laozi.
Bajie made it in Metro City.
Rocket Girl found it at school.

questions.explanation: 火武士说明罐子属于老子，是蝾螈偷走的。

questions.question: What does Wujing ask Rocket Girl to teach him?

options.text: How to control a cloud
How to rule Metro City
How to shoot fire from his eyes

questions.explanation: 悟净希望学会从眼睛发出火焰。

questions.question: Why does Roxy give Terrell a thankful look?

options.text: He has brought her a new watch.
His explanation helps cover up her secret identity.
He has defeated the salamander alone.

questions.explanation: Terrell 解释 Roxy 刚探亲回来，帮助她掩饰与 Rocket Girl 的身份联系，因此她用眼神感谢他。
